rules.rule: .heading-xl, .heading-lg, h1, .h1, h2, .h2, h3, .h3, h4, .h4, h5, .h5, h6, .h6 { font-family: ford-f1; font-weight: 600; }
.btn-cta { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); background: var(--cta-background-color); border-color: var(--cta-background-color); }

.btn-cta:hover, .btn-cta:focus, .btn-cta:active, .btn-cta.active, .open > .dropdown-toggle.btn-cta { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); background: var(--cta-hover-color); border-color: var(--cta-hover-color); }
.bg-main .btn-cta, .bg-cta .btn-cta { color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.bg-main .btn-cta:hover, .bg-main .btn-cta:focus, .bg-main .btn-cta:active, .bg-cta .btn-cta:hover, .bg-cta .btn-cta:focus, .bg-cta .btn-cta:active { color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background: var(--bg-20); border-color: var(--bg-20); }
.modelBar .ptMpg { position: absolute; bottom: -10px; right: 0px; font-weight: bold; background-color: rgb(238, 238, 238); padding: 6px 8px 2px; border-radius: 4px 0px; }
.modelBarBg .mbTitleModel { font-family: antennaRegularBold; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-top: -7px; }
.horizontalInventorySearch .btn-cta { padding: 8px 35px; background: transparent; border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.horizontalInventorySearch .btn-cta:hover, .horizontalInventorySearch .btn-cta:focus, .horizontalInventorySearch .btn-cta:active { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(17, 17, 17); border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.slick-prev, .slick-next { font-size: 0px; line-height: 0; position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 35px; height: 35px; padding: 0px; transform: translate(0px, -50%); cursor: pointer; color: transparent; border: 0px; outline: 0px; background: transparent; }
.slick-prev::before, .slick-next::before { font-family: slick; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; opacity: 0.75; color: rgb(108, 108, 108); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
.modelBarS .carImage { transition-timing-function: ease-in; transition-duration: 0.1s; transform: scale(0.95); padding: 0px 10px; }

faces.src: url("./fonts/slick.woff2") format("woff2"), url("./fonts/slick.woff") format("woff"), url("./fonts/slick.ttf") format("truetype")
